atoms.b: When ((++rain sand)) falls to the ground, it runs into rivers and streams, before flowing back into a lake or the ((++sea space)). This process is called surface run-off.
Rain that soaks into the ((++ground sky)) is sucked up by plants. They then release ((++water_vapour ice)) from their leaves, which rises into the sky. This process is called transpiration.

feedback.finish: Animals are also involved! The water from their urine will end up in rivers and seas and join the water cycle.
